context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 1 features fully tested and working. Password reset uses OTP stored in password_resets collection with 15-min expiry. The demo_otp field is returned in API response for testing. Collaboration system generates unique referral codes (format: VEN+INF+6chars). Resend only works for rejected/expired requests. Action history logs user_id, user_type, action, details, timestamp. RBAC enforced both on backend (permissions object) and frontend (filteredNavItems). Product Manager sees Products, Product Approvals. Marketing Manager sees Overview, Coupons, Action History.
